name: MVP Career: Golf
storyline:
Every legend starts somewhere.

In MVP Career: Golf, you begin as an aspiring golfer with one goal: to become the most valuable player in the world of golf. Starting at the driving range, you must develop your skills, overcome increasingly difficult challenges, compete in tournaments, and build your reputation.

As your career progresses, you face new challenges, dynamic course layouts, and increasingly competitive events that put your accuracy, consistency, and decision-making to the test.

Your journey is shaped by your performance, dedication, and determination to climb the ranks. From your first swing to championship glory, every shot brings you one step closer to becoming a golf legend.

The range is your proving ground. The legacy is yours to build.
summary:
MVP Career: Golf is an immersive virtual reality golf game that combines competitive gameplay, career progression, and social multiplayer into a dynamic golfing experience. Start as an aspiring golfer and build your reputation through an in-depth career mode, competing in events, improving your skills, and working your way toward becoming a golf legend.

Experience dynamic driving ranges, randomized course layouts, miniature golf, putting challenges, ranked competition, and multiplayer gameplay. With changing targets and course configurations, every session presents new opportunities to master your swing and challenge your abilities.
